description: A team of junior developers, lazy mfs (also delinquent)
summary: You are the first ever person to live on Mars. It is beautiful here, but it is not a vacation. You need to face everyday challenges and make tradeoffs. You can either dig minerals more but you can end up with no oxygen; or you can stay in the outpost but make no progress. Conduct researches and develop your camp. YOU are RESPONSIBLE for the FUTURE, SCIENCE, and PROGRESS. So, we wish you good luck. Enjoy your time on Mars - a brand new home for humanity.
details:
It is a game for 7 - 12 year olds children that aims to make exploring the space more interesting for such young minds. Our children is our successors and it is they who will penetrate new environments including Mars

First steps on Mars are challenging. You need to balance radiation, oxygen. The only source of oxygen is ice sheets. You need to study local minerals to enhance your own base and contribute to the science. The genre is farm simulator but not on Earth.

This game will show children that although it is difficult, it can be very interesting to explore the sky.
